# Synthetic fixture library for album-tool tests (plan Step 7).
#
# Every album name, artist name and MBID here is invented — the real
# library lives under the gitignored album-data/ and is never committed.
# Shape mirrors MPD's own `key: value` response lines, one block per song,
# a `file:` line always starting a new record. Read by
# `library::FixtureLibrarySource`, which shares the same parser
# (`mpd_wire::parse_directory_listing`) as the real MPD implementation.
#
# Deliberately covers, per plan Step 7:
#   - all six tag_state values (see per-album comments below)
#   - a Date of '0000' (Quiet Static, Becky's Wedding Edits)
#   - a multi-disc album with continuous track numbering (Driftwood Choir)
#   - a missing AlbumArtist (Vega Transmission, Rowan Ashworth)
#   - a path containing an apostrophe (A Midnight Call for the '90s Kids)
#   - all four path patterns from albumdb::parse_album_path

# --- Albums/A/Aurora Fields/Glass Horizon -- clean ---

Album: Glass Horizon
AlbumArtist: Aurora Fields
Artist: Aurora Fields
Title: Waking Light
